story_description: Implement SwiftUI views for browsing and selecting registry items (skills, plugins, agents) during onboarding, with consistent grid layouts, search, filtering, and selection state management integrated with OnboardingViewModel.
task_description: Create the SwiftUI view for browsing and selecting agents from the registry during onboarding, with use-case-based filtering (Planning, Debugging, Security, Research, Workflow), grid layout of agent cards, multi-select checkboxes, and integration with RegistryCoordinator and OnboardingViewModel.
atom_description: Implement AgentsSelectionView in Blaze/Sources/Onboarding/AgentsSelectionView.swift as a SwiftUI view displaying available agents from the registry in a filterable grid layout. The view features a horizontal chip bar for use-case filtering (All, Planning, Debugging, Security, Research, Workflow), a search bar for text filtering by name/description, a LazyVGrid of AgentCard components showing agent name/description/required-skills/CLI-compatibility, checkbox-based multi-selection persisted to OnboardingViewModel.selectedAgents, and empty state handling when no agents match filters. View observes RegistryCoordinator for agent data and OnboardingViewModel for selection state.
problem_statement: During onboarding, users need to discover and select agents that automate common workflows. Without a dedicated agents selection view with use-case filtering, users would face an overwhelming unfiltered list, making it difficult to find agents relevant to their needs (e.g., a user focused on debugging wants to see debugging agents prominently, not wade through planning agents).

FR-03: All chip shows all agents regardless of use case
FR-04: Search bar below chip bar filters agents by name and description substring match

FR-07: AgentCard displays agent name as title, description as subtitle, required skills as tag pills, CLI compatibility as badges

implementation_steps: Create Blaze/Sources/Onboarding/AgentsSelectionView.swift with file header and imports (SwiftUI, Foundation)
Define UseCase enum with cases all, planning, debugging, security, research, workflow, each with displayName String and iconName String computed properties
Define AgentsSelectionView struct with @EnvironmentObject var viewModel: OnboardingViewModel and @EnvironmentObject var registry: RegistryCoordinator
Add @State private var selectedUseCase: UseCase = .all for filter chip state
Add @State private var searchText: String = empty string for search bar state
Add @State private var debouncedSearchText: String = empty string for debounced search
Implement computed var filteredAgents: [AgentItem] that filters registry.agents by selectedUseCase and debouncedSearchText
Implement body computed property with VStack containing filterChipBar, searchBar, and agentGrid
Implement filterChipBar as HStack of ForEach over UseCase.allCases creating FilterChip views with selection binding
Implement searchBar as TextField with magnifying glass icon and clear button, bound to searchText with .onChange debouncing to debouncedSearchText
Implement agentGrid as ScrollView containing LazyVGrid with adaptive GridItem columns (minimum 280pt)
Within LazyVGrid ForEach over filteredAgents creating AgentCard views with selection binding
Implement AgentCard as VStack with agent.name Text, agent.description Text, requiredSkills HStack of tag pills, forCli HStack of CLI badges, and selection checkbox
Implement checkbox as Image(systemName:) toggling between checkmark.circle.fill and circle based on viewModel.selectedAgents.contains(agent.id)
Add onTapGesture to AgentCard that toggles selection via viewModel.toggleAgentSelection(agent)
Implement emptyStateView as VStack with magnifying glass icon, no agents found message, and Clear Filters button
Implement loadingStateView as VStack with ProgressView spinner and Loading agents message
Implement errorStateView as VStack with exclamation mark icon, error message, and Retry button calling registry.fetchAgents()
Add .onAppear modifier to trigger registry.fetchAgentsIfNeeded()
Add .onChange(of: searchText) with 300ms debounce using Task.sleep updating debouncedSearchText
Add .animation(.easeInOut, value: filteredAgents) for smooth grid updates
Add accessibility labels to all interactive elements
Create FilterChip subview component with label, isSelected binding, and consistent styling
Create AgentCard subview component encapsulating card layout and selection logic
Add selectedCount computed property returning viewModel.selectedAgents.count
Add header Text showing Selected agents count when count greater than zero

mitigations: Coordinate with registry data schema to ensure useCase/tags field exists on AgentItem

Set minimum window width constraint to prevent extreme narrow layouts
Use fixed-height cards with text truncation for consistent grid appearance
Test VoiceOver during development using Accessibility Inspector and real macOS VoiceOver
risk_register.blast_radius: Low - view is isolated onboarding step with no impact on core session functionality. Selection state is in-memory only. Worst case: agents step fails and user skips, continuing onboarding without agent selection.
risk_register.fallback_plan: If view has critical bugs, hide agents step in onboarding flow by skipping AgentsSelectionView. User can install agents later via Settings or Registry browser. No data loss since selection is ephemeral.
